notes: Background: ClearShelf powers product discovery for mid-market ecommerce SaaS customers (catalogs 100k-5M items).
Primary goal: Replace slow keyword ES scoring with dense-retrieval + reranker for better recall and relevance across long-tail SKUs.
Why Redwood: interested in unified hosted -> dedicated path, clear latency profiles, and cost levers (batching/quantization).
Performance targets: 95th pctile query latency < 120ms for single-query API, sustained batch-throughput 50k embeddings/hr for nightly re-index jobs.
Vector DB integration: currently using self-hosted Elastic + custom vector plugin; looking for guidance on connectors (Redis/Pinecone alternatives) and recommended shard sizing.
POC scope: 1) ingest 4M rows nightly, 2) online retrieval via hosted API, 3) canary rollback to keyword search for safety, 4) end-to-end cost estimate for hosted vs dedicated.
Observed during POC: KV cache inefficiency on repeated prefix queries; Diego recommended prefix caching + smaller seq lengths for product titles.
Security: Customer IT insists on SSO + audit logs, EU data residency for ~10% of customers; Private deployment considered long-term.
